title: Arc Mainnet activity report
description: Counts and sums of public Arc Mainnet activity over a fixed block range: transactions, senders, contract creations, gas, USDC transfers, hourly series and most-used contracts. Facts only; no success rates, attribution or quality claims.

artifact.delivery: private; released only to pool members by the delivery service

terms.summary: Cohort licence: members may use the file for personal or internal review and quote short excerpts with attribution; no redistribution or resale. Real USDC on Arc Mainnet; unaudited code; no refunds; USDC pause/blocklist risk disclosed; independent of Circle and Arc.

generator.note: Open script; re-running with the same range reproduces the data (generatedAt differs).
